personal.preferred_title: Senior AWS Data Engineer | Lakehouse, Glue/PySpark, SQL & AI-Assisted Delivery

summary: Senior AWS Data Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience and strong hands-on background in AWS data platforms, Python, SQL, PySpark/Spark, AWS Glue, S3 lakehouse patterns, Athena, Redshift, ETL/ELT pipelines, data quality, metadata documentation, production troubleshooting, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. Experienced designing scalable data workflows, validating architecture decisions through implementation, optimizing SQL and pipeline performance, and delivering governed reporting datasets for regulated enterprise environments. Best aligned to AWS lakehouse roles requiring Glue/PySpark, S3, SQL, pipeline reliability, DQ/metadata patterns, CI/CD-aware delivery, and practical AI acceleration; CDK, dbt Core, Lake Formation, and event-driven AWS services are positioned as adjacent/active-learning areas rather than overstated production ownership.

Partnered with infrastructure, analytics, application, and business stakeholders to validate data architecture decisions, refine reporting requirements, and translate design into production-ready pipeline behavior.

Used AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate Python pipeline work, documentation, quality review, JSON artifact generation, and repeatable delivery practices while preserving engineering review discipline.
